items.q: him and Hal Singer. And they used to come and stand in front of the band at the dances when I was down there with George E. Lee, and listen to me play

ctx.x: Just a second. So what were you saying Budd?

As I said Don Byas asked me, said hey Budd, why don't you come on and take this job because I'm going to join Duke Ellington's orchestra. I said, oh, yeah, when? He says, well I can join it right away, he says, so why don't you just come on and take this job and I'll go on over there and you've got you a job while you're here. Well, you know, Don Byas -- Don Byas I had known since he was a little kid, because when I used to play down through Oklahoma he was from Muskogee, Oklahoma, and him and Hal Singer. And…
Okay, so that night I stayed on after the show, after it was over, and we rehearsed. And then I started to work --
